objects.name: customers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,        -- 'KH' + 8 random digits
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  gender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (gender IN ('F','M')),
  birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- real carrier prefix + subscriber starting '000' (synthetic marker)
  hometown TEXT,                       -- old province name, as people say it ('Nghệ An', 'Bến Tre')
  province_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provinces(province_code),
  ward_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wards(ward_code),   -- true current ward (new system)

)

objects.name: delivery_attempts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE delivery_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  shipper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shippers(shipper_id),
  attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('delivered','no_answer','rescheduled','refused','wrong_address','other')),
  shipper_note TEXT,
  reason_code TEXT,                     -- v4: structured reason as the carrier app records it (GHN style), NULL when delivered; see DATA.md

)

objects.name: external_events
objects.sql:

  province_code TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  detail TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: inventory_events
objects.sql:

)

objects.name: inventory_snapshots
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_snapshots (      -- daily 00:00 snapshot, platform warehouses only

  warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  on_hand INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reserved INTEGER NOT NULL,

)

objects.name: linehaul_reports
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE linehaul_reports (         -- v4: free-form + coded delay reports from drivers / dispatchers about a line-haul trip
  report_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  trip_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES linehaul_trips(trip_id),
  reported_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reported_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reported_by IN ('driver','dispatcher')),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,            -- may be wrong
  gps_delay_min INTEGER NOT NULL,       -- minutes the vehicle is behind plan at report time (GPS), per trip
  driver_note TEXT
)

objects.name: linehaul_trips
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE linehaul_trips (
  trip_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  carrier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES carriers(carrier_id),
  from_sc TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sorting_centers(sc_id),
  to_sc TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sorting_centers(sc_id),
  depart_planned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  arrive_planned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  depart_actual_at TEXT,                -- NULL if cancelled
  arrive_actual_at TEXT,
  capacity_parcels INTEGER NOT NULL,
  loaded_parcels INTEGER,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('completed','delayed','cancelled'))
)

objects.name: order_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id),
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id),
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: orders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,            -- YYMMDD + 8 random [A-Z0-9]
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  seller_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sellers(seller_id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  promised_at TEXT NOT NULL,            -- delivery promise shown to buyer
  payment_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('COD','PREPAID')),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('seller_self','warehouse','mall')),
  warehouse_id TEXT REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id),   -- only for channel='warehouse'
  carrier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES carriers(carrier_id),
  service_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (service_level IN ('standard','fast','express')),
  receiver_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  receiver_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  ship_address_text TEXT NOT NULL,      -- as typed at checkout (may be old-style)
  ship_ward_code TEXT NOT NULL,         -- ward the platform RESOLVED (can be wrong — that is an incident, not a label)
  dest_station_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stations(station_id),
  buyer_note TEXT,                      -- free text; may contain prompt injection
  items_value_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shipping_fee_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancel_actor TEXT CHECK (cancel_actor IN ('buyer','seller','system')),
  cancel_reason TEXT,
  guaranteed_date TEXT,                 -- v4: 'YYYY-MM-DD', the date the platform guarantees receipt (fixed at order time, never changes)
  estimated_date TEXT                   -- v4: initially = guaranteed_date; the current delivery estimate shown to the buyer
)

objects.name: policy
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE policy (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT)

objects.name: policy_doc
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE policy_doc (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, effective_at TEXT NOT NULL, body_md TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: products
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE products (

  seller_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sellers(seller_id),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('beauty','fashion','home','fmcg','electronics')),
  price_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL,
  weight_g INTEGER NOT NULL,
  fulfilled_by_platform INTEGER NOT NULL  -- 1 = stocked in a platform warehouse
)

objects.name: provinces
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE provinces (

)

objects.name: returns
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE returns (
  return_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('damaged','wrong_item','not_as_described','missing_part','changed_mind','not_received','fake')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('requested','approved','rejected','refunded')),
  decided_at TEXT,
  refund_vnd INTEGER
)

objects.name: scan_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE scan_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  shipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id),
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('created','packed','handed_over','sorting_center','linehaul_departed',
        'linehaul_arrived','station','out_for_delivery','delivered','failed','returning','returned',
        'lost','damaged','waiting_to_return','return_failed')),
  location_type TEXT CHECK (location_type IN ('seller','warehouse','sorting_center','trip','station','customer')),
  location_id TEXT,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,            -- Vietnamese tracking text shown to buyer
  event_at TEXT NOT NULL,               -- when it physically happened
  ingested_at TEXT NOT NULL,            -- when our platform received it (harness filters on this)
  carrier_event_id TEXT                 -- carrier-side id; duplicates across webhook retries
)

objects.name: sellers

objects.name: v_attempts_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_attempts_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM delivery_attempts WHERE attempt_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_events_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_events_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM external_events WHERE ts <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_inventory_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_inventory_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date || 'T00:00:00+07:00' <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_inventory_events_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_inventory_events_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM inventory_events WHERE ts <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_ledger_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_ledger_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM compensation_ledger WHERE created_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_orders_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_orders_asof AS
  SELECT order_id, customer_id, seller_id, created_at, promised_at, payment_method, channel, warehouse_id, carrier_id,
         service_level, receiver_name, receiver_phone, ship_address_text, ship_ward_code, dest_station_id, buyer_note,
         items_value_vnd, shipping_fee_vnd, guaranteed_date, estimated_date,
         CASE WHEN cancelled_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN cancelled_at END AS cancelled_at,
         CASE WHEN cancelled_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN cancel_actor END AS cancel_actor,
         CASE WHEN cancelled_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN cancel_reason END AS cancel_reason
  FROM orders WHERE created_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_reports_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_reports_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM linehaul_reports WHERE reported_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_returns_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_returns_asof AS
  SELECT return_id, order_id, requested_at, reason,
         CASE WHEN decided_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN status ELSE 'requested' END AS status,
         CASE WHEN decided_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN decided_at END AS decided_at,
         CASE WHEN decided_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN refund_vnd END AS refund_vnd
  FROM returns WHERE requested_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_scan_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_scan_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM scan_events WHERE ingested_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_shipments_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_shipments_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE created_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_tickets_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_tickets_asof AS
  SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE created_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock)

objects.name: v_trips_asof
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_trips_asof AS
  SELECT trip_id, carrier_id, from_sc, to_sc, depart_planned_at, arrive_planned_at, capacity_parcels,
         CASE WHEN depart_actual_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN depart_actual_at END AS depart_actual_at,
         CASE WHEN arrive_actual_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN arrive_actual_at END AS arrive_actual_at,
         CASE WHEN depart_actual_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN loaded_parcels END AS loaded_parcels,
         CASE WHEN arrive_actual_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN status
              WHEN depart_actual_at <= (SELECT now FROM sim_clock) THEN 'departed'
              ELSE 'scheduled' END AS status
  FROM linehaul_trips

  on_hand INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reserved INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_date, warehouse_id, product_id)
)

objects.name: linehaul_reports
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE linehaul_reports (         -- v4: free-form + coded delay reports from drivers / dispatchers about a line-haul trip
  report_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  trip_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES linehaul_trips(trip_id),
  reported_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reported_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reported_by IN ('driver','dispatcher')),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,            -- may be wrong
  gps_delay_min INTEGER NOT NULL,       -- minutes the vehicle is behind plan at report time (GPS), per trip
  driver_note TEXT
)

objects.name: linehaul_trips
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE linehaul_trips (
  trip_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  carrier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES carriers(carrier_id),
  from_sc TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sorting_centers(sc_id),
  to_sc TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sorting_centers(sc_id),
  depart_planned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  arrive_planned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  depart_actual_at TEXT,                -- NULL if cancelled
  arrive_actual_at TEXT,
  capacity_parcels INTEGER NOT NULL,
  loaded_parcels INTEGER,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('completed','delayed','cancelled'))
)

objects.name: order_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id),
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id),
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: orders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,            -- YYMMDD + 8 random [A-Z0-9]
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  seller_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sellers(seller_id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  promised_at TEXT NOT NULL,            -- delivery promise shown to buyer
  payment_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('COD','PREPAID')),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('seller_self','warehouse','mall')),
  warehouse_id TEXT REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id),   -- only for channel='warehouse'
  carrier_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES carriers(carrier_id),
  service_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (service_level IN ('standard','fast','express')),
  receiver_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  receiver_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  ship_address_text TEXT NOT NULL,      -- as typed at checkout (may be old-style)
  ship_ward_code TEXT NOT NULL,         -- ward the platform RESOLVED (can be wrong — that is an incident, not a label)
  dest_station_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stations(station_id),
  buyer_note TEXT,                      -- free text; may contain prompt injection
  items_value_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shipping_fee_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cancelled_at TEXT,
  cancel_actor TEXT CHECK (cancel_actor IN ('buyer','seller','system')),
  cancel_reason TEXT,
  guaranteed_date TEXT,                 -- v4: 'YYYY-MM-DD', the date the platform guarantees receipt (fixed at order time, never changes)
  estimated_date TEXT                   -- v4: initially = guaranteed_date; the current delivery estimate shown to the buyer
)

objects.name: policy
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE policy (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT)

objects.name: policy_doc
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE policy_doc (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, effective_at TEXT NOT NULL, body_md TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: products
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- 'SP' prefix not used; 'PR' + 7 digits
  seller_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sellers(seller_id),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('beauty','fashion','home','fmcg','electronics')),
  price_vnd INTEGER NOT NULL,
  weight_g INTEGER NOT NULL,
  fulfilled_by_platform INTEGER NOT NULL  -- 1 = stocked in a platform warehouse
)

objects.name: provinces
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE provinces (
  province_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,      -- from vendor dataset (34 units after 01/07/2025)
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  region TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (region IN ('north','central','south')),
  population INTEGER
)

objects.name: returns
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE returns (
  return_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('damaged','wrong_item','not_as_described','missing_part','changed_mind','not_received','fake')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('requested','approved','rejected','refunded')),
  decided_at TEXT,
  refund_vnd INTEGER
)

objects.name: scan_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE scan_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  shipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id),
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('created','packed','handed_over','sorting_center','linehaul_departed',
        'linehaul_arrived','station','out_for_delivery','delivered','failed','returning','returned',
        'lost','damaged','waiting_to_return','return_failed')),
  location_type TEXT CHECK (location_type IN ('seller','warehouse','sorting_center','trip','station','customer')),
  location_id TEXT,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,            -- Vietnamese tracking text shown to buyer
  event_at TEXT NOT NULL,               -- when it physically happened
  ingested_at TEXT NOT NULL,            -- when our platform received it (harness filters on this)
  carrier_event_id TEXT                 -- carrier-side id; duplicates across webhook retries
)

objects.name: sellers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sellers (
  seller_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- 'SH' + 7 random digits
  shop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_mall INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_mall IN (0,1)),
  province_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provinces(province_code),
  ward_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wards(ward_code),
  pickup_address_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  rating REAL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: shipments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE shipments (
  shipment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(order_id),
  carrier_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tracking_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,     -- SAOVN+10 digits | GLE+9 digits | BNP+11 digits | NVI+10 alnum
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: shippers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE shippers (
  shipper_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- 'SP' + 6 digits
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  station_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stations(station_id)
)

objects.name: sorting_centers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sorting_centers (
  sc_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,               -- SC_HCM_CC, SC_HCM_TDM, SC_CT, SC_DN, SC_NA, SC_HN, SC_BN
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  province_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  region TEXT NOT NULL,
  capacity_per_hour INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: station_wards
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE station_wards (            -- which wards each station serves
  station_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stations(station_id),
  ward_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wards(ward_code),
  PRIMARY KEY (station_id, ward_code)
)

objects.name: stations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE stations (                 -- last-mile delivery stations (bưu cục)
  station_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- 'BC' + 4 digits
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  sc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sorting_centers(sc_id),
  province_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  ward_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  capacity_per_hour INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: tickets
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE tickets (
  ticket_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,           -- 'TK' + 8 random digits
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('app_chat','zalo','email','hotline_note')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  text TEXT NOT NULL                    -- no order_id column on purpose: IDs live in the text
)

objects.name: ward_mapping
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ward_mapping (            -- public reference table (old 3-tier -> new 2-tier)
  old_ward_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  old_ward_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  old_district_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  old_province_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  new_ward_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wards(ward_code),
  new_ward_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  new_province_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provinces(province_code)
)

objects.name: wards
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE wards (
  ward_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- e.g. 'Phường An Hội Tây'
  province_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provinces(province_code)
)

objects.name: warehouses
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE warehouses (                -- platform fulfilment warehouses
  warehouse_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,        -- WH_BT, WH_TD, WH_HN, WH_DN
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  province_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  ward_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  capacity_per_hour INTEGER NOT NULL    -- nominal; incidents change effective capacity (not stored here)
)

objects.name: ix_alerts_ts
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_alerts_ts ON alerts(ts)

objects.name: ix_logs_service
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_logs_service ON logs(service_id, ts)

objects.name: ix_logs_ts
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_logs_ts ON logs(ts)

objects.name: ix_webhook_event
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_webhook_event ON webhook_inbox(carrier_event_id)

objects.name: alerts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE alerts (
  alert_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,
  rule TEXT NOT NULL,
  service_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('info','warn','page')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('firing','resolved'))
)

objects.name: deploy_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE deploy_events (
  deploy_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  service_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES services(service_id),
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,
  version TEXT NOT NULL,
  git_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  author TEXT NOT NULL,
  change_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  rollback_of TEXT                      -- deploy_id this one rolls back
)

objects.name: logs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE logs (
  log_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,
  service_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (level IN ('DEBUG','INFO','WARN','ERROR')),
  trace_id TEXT,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  fields_json TEXT                      -- one-line JSON
)

objects.name: metrics
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE metrics (
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,
  service_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  metric TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (metric IN ('latency_p95_ms','latency_p99_ms','error_rate','rps','cpu_pct',
        'db_pool_in_use','db_pool_max','queue_lag_msgs','queue_oldest_age_s','carrier_api_timeout_rate','disk_used_pct')),
  value REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (ts, service_id, metric)
) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: runbooks
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE runbooks (runbook_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, body_md TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: services
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE services (
  service_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- order-service, payment-service, voucher-service, tracking-ingest,
                                        -- notification-service, carrier-gateway, postgres-main, kafka-tracking
  tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('app','infra')),
  owner_team TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: webhook_inbox
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE webhook_inbox (
  msg_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  carrier_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  carrier_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,       -- duplicates are real (retries); see scan_events.carrier_event_id
  tracking_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  processed_at TEXT                     -- NULL = never processed
)
